title: Every node role, drawn
description: The seven roles a node may take, each drawn as the bundled default theme draws it: start and terminal are pills, with the terminal in a heavier line; a step is a plain rectangle; a decision is a diamond; emphasis is a rectangle at the heavier weight; a note has no outline at all; and a group is a dashed rectangle. An author names the role and the theme decides the shape, so a different theme draws this same document differently.
caption: Say what the box is, not what it looks like — the shape follows.

nodes.text:
step
the ordinary box, and the default

decision

emphasis

note

group
a container, drawn around others
